name: SpendZero: No Spend Tracker
subtitle: No-Buy Savings Challenge Game
promotionalText: New: seal every no-spend day with a golden coin, watch your own wealth tree grow gold coins, and keep your streak alive from the Home Screen widget. Now in 10 languages.
description:
Turn not spending into winning. SpendZero is a no-spend challenge that rewards every day you keep your money — with streaks, XP, quests, badges, and a wealth tree that grows gold coins as you save.

SEAL YOUR DAY
Mark a no-spend day and watch it get stamped with a golden coin. Your streak counts up, your rewards pop in, and you see exactly how close you are to your next milestone. It takes one tap — and it feels great every single time.

GROW YOUR WEALTH TREE
Your tree is one of a kind. It grows a little with every level, hangs gold coins as your savings pile up, and glows when your streak is alive. Miss too many days and it gets thirsty — log a no-spend day to bring it back.

A GAME YOU WIN BY NOT SPENDING
• Streaks with streak freezes that save you on a bad day
• Daily and weekly quests that progress from what you actually do
• 25 levels, from Frugal Novice to Wealth King
• Badges for 7, 30, 100 and 365-day streaks and savings milestones
• Challenges like the 7-Day No-Spend Sprint, Coffee Detox and the 30-Day No-Spend Challenge

CRUSH IMPULSE BUYS
Felt the urge to buy? Log it. Resist it and the money counts as saved, with XP to prove it. Gave in? No shame — log it and keep going. Groceries and transport don't break your no-spend day.

NEVER BREAK THE CHAIN
• Interactive Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets: mark today without opening the app
• Siri and Shortcuts: "Log a no-spend day in SpendZero"
• A gentle evening check-in at the time you usually log — with one-tap buttons
• Forgot yesterday? A morning reminder lets you count it before your streak breaks

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
A streak calendar with day-by-day detail, savings charts, and a shareable story card every time you seal a day. Export a PDF report whenever you like.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything you log stays on your iPhone. No account, no sign-up, no ads, no tracking.

Available in English, Spanish, French, German, Dutch, Italian, Portuguese, Turkish, Japanese and Chinese.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
SpendZero Pro is available weekly, monthly or yearly, or as a one-time lifetime purchase. Monthly and yearly plans may include a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers. Prices are shown in the app in your local currency. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel at any time in your App Store account settings.
